run_vertex_agent_test: run the Vertex AI Reasoning Engine test script to authenticate and send a query
create_vertex_session: create a session on a Vertex AI Reasoning Engine using the async_create_session method
query_reasoning_engine: send a streaming query to a Vertex AI Reasoning Engine via the streamQuery endpoint
authenticate_google_cloud: authenticate with Google Cloud using google-auth default credentials and refresh the token
build_vertex_endpoint_url: build the Vertex AI Reasoning Engine query and streamQuery endpoint URLs from project config
